title: Student Support Coordinator
bio: I want students to be able to utilize me as a safe space to be able to meet with me in times of need and when they need support. If students need support regarding leaves of absence, hospitalizations or emergency travel coordination please come and meet with me. If students are struggling and are not sure what resources to utilize, I would encourage them to meet with me. I am also a resource for acclimating back to campus and want to ensure that every student is met with care, support and on track to succeed during their time at Harvard College. In my spare time, I love to explore new coffee shops, libraries and restaurants. I really enjoy spending time outside whether it is near the beach or hiking in the mountains. I enjoy the intentional time that I spend with my family and friends and any moment I get the chance to, I go up to Maine as it is my favorite place. A fun fact about me is I have a deep admiration for Jane Austen and am finishing up my PhD in English! Area Residential Life Role Central
